notes.title: Discussing Maps of Oblivion Override - Theme Design, Level Gameplay, and New Map
notes.content:
Hello again adventurers!

So far, we've given you glimpses into the diverse weapon selection in [i]Oblivion Override[/i], and there's so much more we'd like to share! While combat is the heart and soul of this action side-scroller, we believe and value that creating an immersive and thoughtful level design is just as important. In this dev blog, we will be diving into some of the initial thoughts and ideas behind the maps and levels. We’ll also share a sneak peek of the undisclosed 3rd level.

While each level in [i]Oblivion Override[/i] is designed with an independent philosophy in mind, we try to keep the narrative cohesive during development so that all levels align well with the overarching theme - [b]the AI takeover of the post-apocalyptic wasteland[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/6812b52a8e4686c6638d4d0ba14100e3c7ead6a0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Abandoned Factory[/h2]

As our first map, the Abandoned Factory serves as a deep dive into the radical technological background of our game's world and the negative impacts that come with it - presented in a captivating diesel-punk visual style. The level is characterized by massive and rumbling machines powered by electricity and fuel, abandoned manufacturing stations, and empty, desolate workshops. Together, they create a palpable sense of decay and desolation, reinforced by a consistent color palette of sandy yellows and scattered metallic debris throughout the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/b453a996c7d172ef9c7480f1c7e5b466da72da90.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/a3ed678ab4d3a208a131c114085e7d5c9eedb6f0.jpg[/img]

The conflict between mechanical oppression and rebellion is embodied in the setting of [i]War Factory[/i], which includes the design of both the background elements and the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/b948a1c818233a6cc3f684f55ed976f9a2c2465e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mutant Greenhouse[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/a96e42539527e4ae9149980bfdb8e5cad8fe744e.jpg[/img]

The greenhouse map is densely filled with shuttle pipe designs inspired by Metroid, which are intended to create a sense of crisis and enclosed escape, reminiscent of a laboratory or sewer style. Throughout the scene, the extensive proliferation of vegetation can be seen, with various animal skulls and bizarre plants soaking in the incomplete biological vessels, and walls adorned with a variety of biohazard labels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/4dd3b7adf79588e6c6a126933175a81434747518.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/4bbf92655349789d7f980df5f1177cbc7adbdb1a.jpg[/img]

To enhance the sense of biological invasion, we incorporated a ‘biological parasitism’ element into the throwing-type robots - their heads are covered with a cluster of twisted mushrooms. Enemies with headlamps metal pipes were also influenced by the accident-prone sewer setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/d0d98c243dfd8403a1e6ed07fefb835cab2f7267.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tie-in with Gameplay[/h2]

Like many side-scrolling action games, we inevitably had to draw inspirations from the classic [i]Castlevania[/i] series in many ways. However, [i]Oblivion Override[/i] is more of an action game: apart from the exploration, we also added mandatory arena fights that are familiar to action game players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/fdffa9d9e0902b7ef74fcd78500a5f46836d182e.gif[/img]

In addition to the essential teleporters, the exploration also retains the classic setup of secret areas, waiting to reward adventurous players with a potential core, a great fortune, or even catch them off guard with deadly monsters lurking in the shadows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/83772581c4c6714fe7a5a26d59a24e315ec609b2.gif[/img]

That’s not to say we didn’t want to present something unique, which is why we designed the abandoned factory with spacious platforms and towering walls, allowing adventurers to exploit their movement capabilities such as wall running and dashing. On the other hand, the cramped and narrow terrain of the mutant greenhouse limits mobility, replacing high walls and stairs with winding pipes that force players to traverse between different areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/9bf8d44efa05584b5eae69fdeef43000d9918db6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/0155208ae4845b9d292f36cdefacdadc578ec157.gif[/img]

We also incorporated some traps into the game in line with the style of each map to enrich gameplay and also difficulty. In the abandoned factory, players must jump and dash around the electrified contraptions scattered throughout the level like a parkour expert. And in the second map, the traps would evolve into spikes that protrude from carnivorous plants on the walls, which require much more accurate maneuvering skills around these narrow spaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/d60ddb92a1c6a19698c3469bfcf83a97b3be02d2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/b924af961b7f97afcf6516ae853123f953b8304f.gif[/img]

More than just obstacles, these traps also offer interesting opportunities. For example, players can knock enemies onto electric traps and spikes for an instant kill, or take advantage of the indiscriminate delayed attacks from carnivorous plants to add strategic depth to intense combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/0fc80b58bb5a33b276a8a0f7555f6b5744740397.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/c87fdd9724b4740eeac75e06e8037e7ed1f0d83b.gif[/img]

Action game players might be already familiar with the mandatory arena fights. In addition to conventional enemy types, we also added a wide range of different enemy types to provide a differentiated combat experience through randomly generated terrains and traps. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/1c92ec3661448f699314b8cb34deba366b4a3c01.gif[/img]

Certain levels may restrict the room for players to move around while requiring them to dodge bombs dropped from all directions in a limited time. Others generate moving lasers that challenge the player's both combat and evasion skills. Furthermore, some rooms feature many bidirectional pipes, through which ranged enemies can escape and disrupt players’ attack flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/7ab96a1491f3fe7a7c24aa0129ae6ee0a4a0b0c3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/8865f952c2e4f5c475bade18eae3d32d7d23d431.gif[/img]

[i]Oblivion Override[/i] is still a roguelike game, so we hope to provide a unique experience for players through the randomly generated levels. By taking clever advantage of the different terrains and available mechanics in combat, players can strategize and enjoy the game in different ways. 

[h2]A Little Spoilers[/h2]

Finally, as promised, let’s have a sneak peak at the 3rd level once you get past the Mutant Greenhouse - the Data Center. This might be the most futuristic representation of the AI sci-fi theme, with octopus-shaped robots, brain-computer interfaces in the background, and artistic designs reminiscent of neural circuit boards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/3d4079bcc171811660004b4dc1c99d61878931f1.gif[/img]

Of course, we also put a lot of effort into designing the arenas. In addition to the motherboard-like background, the layout of the entire arena changes after each wave of enemies. We use retractable mechanical walls, data stream platforms, and movable laser traps to create dynamic and challenging levels that are constantly evolving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/3844cb28007039a3a2c3a16a17bf4f31416e7430.gif[/img]

That's all for the map and level design of this dev blog! For more info, discussions, and latest updates on [i]Oblivion Override[/i], join our [url=https://discord.gg/49C4wSYDph]official Discord[/url]!

[url=https://discord.gg/49C4wSYDph][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/6a47311c505b5598aee2a9f5b3bd84937d6a83ee.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Let’s Talk About Weapons Vol.2 - New Designs & Energy Mechanics
notes.content:
Hi, adventurers!

It’s been a little while since our first weapon blog, and we’ve been busy digesting feedback and suggestions collected from our communities and feeding into further development. 

As one of the core components of [i]Oblivion Override[/i], the design of weapons has been something many players are most concerned about. In this blog, we will continue to introduce the[b] weapon designs[/b] in [i]Oblivion Override[/i] via aspects including attack moves, unique weapon skills and attributes, as well as a sneak peek into the new weapon skill mechanic - the “[b]energy-based[/b]” weapon.

[h2]New Weapon Design[/h2]
Our last article mainly focused on weapons like daggers and fists. In today’s blog, while some of the weapons to be introduced were those previously locked in the Next Fest demo, we’ve also been reworking them based on your general weapon feedback, and hope to offer a brand-new look of the weapon system to all adventurers.

For example, when we designed the weapon [Prop Sword], we considered “[b]combo attack[/b]” and “[b]swift movement[/b]” as its main features - Compared to normal swords, it increases your displacement distance appropriately through weapon actions to avoid damage in some complicated situations, such as levels with traps and ground thorns. The combo attack allows you to stop the combo and turn to another enemy at any time, which brings much flexibility during battles.

We also made the attack more striking and enhanced skill visual effects for Prop Sword to avoid players being unable to locate the player-character in chaotic combats. And of course, a spectacular combo should have a cool finale, so we added "[b]X Slash[/b]" as the final blow, hoping to deliver the ultimate attack more powerful and impressive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/8eead498b70f74f8054b14a57626532722d51c4a.gif[/img]

Now let’s talk about the new pike weapon - [Javelin]. As a melee weapon, the longer range the better. But it would be a little bit boring if it’s just a simple thrust. So we designed some special attributes for it, such as, "[b]Javelin can come back to you in a rotating way[/b]", and "[b]deal continuous attack when inserted into the wall[/b]". You can toss it out as a ranged weapon and deal constant spinning damage in a rather safe place, which can be particularly useful when facing big and slow enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/8153d6fb2a7c9a54a703263e2b500c20e1255253.gif[/img]

In addition to new weapons, we have also remade [Plasma Sword], one of the popular weapons in the Next Fest DEMO. The new attribute “[b]Plasma Field[/b]” allows you to create an electric triangle at the final hit of the combo and shock enemies in a large range (while it has an 8s cooldown). And with its previous attribute “[b]Remise[/b]” to stun enemies with electric shock, you can combine the two attributes to take crowds of enemies under control in fierce fighting, or help you survive danger in some very moments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/ba6c500931516cdb8980dc5510c7f5d7017f6132.gif[/img]

Also, let’s take a look at the sweetest weapon in our game - [Sawpop]. We retain the rapid rotation attack of its skill “Sweet Storm” in the DEMO version, and add an upgradable stepped-up ability: "release the skill at the 2nd/3rd/4th hit of combo and the skill will be infused with [b]guard-breaking/ blast wave/ HP lifesteal effect[/b]”, which may turn your “button-mashing” into real “tornado-smashing”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/942833e70c3b09f8a43c431f3dd286f6d8f2e0bb.gif[/img]

[h2]New [Energy] Mechanism[/h2]
We have always wanted to provide players with a varied and dynamic combat experience in [i]Oblivion Override[/i]. In the previous DEMO, there were many sorts of weapon skills, but in general, all of these skills have only one refresh mechanism - [time-based cooldown], which is a little bit dull in gameplay.

Therefore, we adjusted the weapon system with a new [b][Energy] mechanic[/b] — in short, it needs some energy to unleash a skill, instead of waiting for the cooldown. The energy can be obtained through attacking enemies, or through special weapon attributes, such as "gain 50 energy points immediately when entering a combat room".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/bc6e43910c1f2f342cde0b2c390a71e7f3d1863c.gif[/img]

Compared with cooldown, which is relatively more like waiting passively, the energy-consuming mechanic emphasizes more on the proactive attack. You can use skills more frequently by keeping on attacking enemies. The more you attack in a fight, the stronger you will be.

[h2]Energy-Based Weapons [/h2]
With the emergence of the [energy-based] mechanism, some weapons under this mechanic can have unexpected performance - without affecting the game balance, the [energy-based] mechanic will not only effectively enhance the power of weapons, but also create some new tactics if you combine their original weapon features wisely.

For example, regarding the weapon [Storm Coil] in the DEMO version, its original skill “Dynamo” was to strike the enemy with a magnetic electric drill, which needed to be activated in appropriate timing because you wouldn’t be able to move when using the skill. But when we turn it into an [Energy] weapon, the skill becomes more convenient and flexible: “[b]It will consume energy continuously when you use it, and you can stop the skill anytime[/b]”, in which way the ease of use and safety can be effectively guaranteed.

Also along with this change is a new weapon attribute, "[b]AC/DC[/b]" which fires a small drill every second when you use “Dynamo”, dealing damage to enemies at a distance. As an energy-consuming bonus, this attribute further increases the frequency of skill use. Now you may beat those big enemies hard as a maniac electric drill man!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/18675f60f8c8fa8963057707ed47c2d7a4031fa3.gif[/img]

The energy-based axe weapon [Ascendance] showcased in the DEMO has an imposing look and attack effects. It can deal tons of wide-range damage when you face a considerable number of enemies. Its [Energy] skill "[b]Lunar Spiral[/b]" has a wide attack range and jumping distance, designed to compensate for the weakness of the axe's slow normal attack speed.

Speaking of which, the slow attack may also make it hard to accumulate energy, so we added another attribute to make it more efficient, “[b]Ex mode[/b]”: hold the skill for 0.3s and it will start to charge itself - you can charge in advance in a safe place before ready to seize the initiative in intense combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/f70f4149aa31b684ee70f13feb15db3a66e5f2c1.gif[/img]

Those inventions, created from cold scraps of rusty metal, may also be filled with longing for traditional festivals from the distant human age. Take the new weapon, [Yuletide], for example. Although it looks like a hammer modified from a Christmas tree, you can use it more than swinging-attack - It has a skill called  "[b]Sleigh Ride[/b]": Ride the Christmas tree and rush to hit the enemy fiercely! By consuming 100 energy points, players can freely change direction during this invincible time, hitting and penetrating enemies along the way.

Of course this entertaining weapon is not just a roadkiller, we also designed additional festive attributes for it, such as “[b]Spark - throwing Christmas presents at intervals during the Sleigh Ride[/b]”. These stars, candies, and bells that splash and explode around should be your surprise Christmas gifts to the gathered enemies on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/725cf9506dcb6f5136a7920b891906ed91c0cb0a.gif[/img]

That's all for today’s sharing of the weapon system! We’re still working on developing more weapons and new gameplay systems which will be gradually revealed in later blogs. If you have any advice for our game, please feel free to leave a comment or join our official Discord server and discuss with fellow adventurers!

notes.title: Weapons in Oblivion Override Vol. 1 - Weapon Preview, Redesign & Recast System
notes.content:
Hi adventurers, good to see you again!

It’s been a while since Next Fest. We've been engaging in a closed development phase based on your demo suggestions and survey feedback since then, fixing crashes and working on weapon optimization & new gameplay content.

In the following few months, we will continuously share our dev progress and secrets behind the Dulce Base, and first of all, let’s talk about the [b]weapon system[/b] - one of the core components of [i]Oblivion Override[/i].

[h2]Overview[/h2]
In [i]Oblivion Override[/i], there are different main types of weapons such as daggers, swords, hammers, axes, and fists. Whether it's slaying through splashing blood with a big axe or dodging through groups of enemies with daggers, we hope the unique skill and random attributes possessed by each weapon can always make your hack-n-slash gameplay refreshing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/8930945581aa96323f5c4b181bf4926fe0099860.png[/img]

Amongst Next Fest demo feedback, we found several main issues about weapons that players are concerned most: 
[olist]
[*] The skill design of some weapons doesn’t lead to smooth slashing experience during battles as we expected;
[*] Some weapon attributes are not powerful enough and cannot fully show the weapon speciality; 
[*] Weapon balance is not good enough that some weapons are much less used than others.
[/olist]
Based on these feedbacks, we immediately set out to optimize and even redesign those weapons, hoping to bring a [b]diverse and balanced weapon gameplay experience[/b] to you at launch.

[h2]Weapon Changes[/h2]
From your feedback, we found that daggers (such as Bayonets), Jet Fists, Supre Slugger, Sawpop, and Storm Coil have a lot of room for improvement in skills and attributes.

For example, the skill of the Bayonets in the DEMO is Binary Vortex, which will cause the character to fly up a bit. We designed it to make Bayonets more flexible, but this brought movement inconvenience in the real game. 

So we've modified the original skill to [b]Roundhouse Kick[/b] - a powerful forward kick that breaks the enemy's guard and triggers rupture. The vertical movement now becomes lateral movement, and the skill can even evolve into a bursting combo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/2e0cfefa440108298f5df660df6fe33e43d3b955.gif[/img]

Besides, we have merged the original attribute "Rupture" into skill, and created a new attribute "[b]Bloodthirsty[/b]" for replacement: 35% chance to restore 1% of max HP when killing an enemy in rupture. This will make Bayonets more useful in fight. 

Another typical weapon, Supre Slugger, has also been optimized - the original attribute was catching the baseball resets its cooldown. We found that during the game, especially in complex situations, it is quite difficult to predict the direction of the baseball and reset cooldown.

So we changed this skill to "[b]Division[/b]": 15% chance to divide a baseball each time it hits an enemy. This makes the weapon more powerful and visually striking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/be7d319eafbdd651f32e1ca87471741a2b801c85.gif[/img]

Additionally, since many demo players reported Jet Fists are not that wieldy because of the low attack speed and long attack animation, [b]we also reworked the attack animation and the skill effect of  "Jab": always strike a heavy punch in 5s after using Flying Fists.[/b] Now Jet Fists are more flexible and its power has been noticeably improved.

Some other weapons have also been modified, but in general, we have appropriately upgraded most of the weapons in terms of performance, ease of use, and skill balance, so that players can fight more smoothly with enjoyment of fast-paced intense combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/71cc7192d0e01d989332a401691c41421cdda985.gif[/img]

[h2]New Weapons Preview[/h2]
In addition to those playable weapons, you can also see some weapons that are only for display in store during the demo playtest, such as Violet Dagger, Grasscutter, and Ascendance. [b]We've also optimized these weapons, and they'll be available upon launch with a new look.[/b]

For example, the Grasscutter that appears in the store — compared to fast daggers and powerful hammers and axes, the performance of the Grasscutter is somewhere in between. Its four-shot combo has a wide range in front, and can even attack flying enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/592152f1d0094be75b4acad7d6bd6c3c04f517cc.gif[/img]

As its name suggests, its blade is designed to be leaf-like with its handle also in the shape of a four-leaf clover, and its skills are naturally related to plants: [b]After smashing, placing a random plant cannon to shoot enemies automatically.[/b] It can be surprisingly helpful in some long boss fights if cannons are placed in the proper location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/d15931c803b23498222bce7ce2379996249dbd35.gif[/img]

Another weapon, Violet Dagger, has a "Ambush" skill that can move behind enemies in a flash and deal high damage. With quick movement, this skill allows you to get close to enemies instantly to backstab. We've adjusted the skill animation, now backstab is more useful in real game, [b]you can attack immediately after ambush.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/06d85274d593c53279822cb4f351ef29a85137f6.gif[/img]

[h2]Weapon Recast System[/h2]
Besides different skill effects, each weapon in [i]Oblivion Override[/i] is also given a variety of random attributes, some of which increase the charge effect, and some can increase the damage to enemies in certain debuff. notes.title: Next Fest Demo is Available Now | Demo Content, Weapons, and Evolution Features
notes.content:
Hi adventurers, welcome aboard!

We are excited to announce that [b]the public demo of [i]Oblivion Override[/i] for the upcoming Steam Next Fest is now available until Feb. 13th[/b]! 

You can download it on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952370]Steam[/url] and come explore the [b]first two major areas[/b] of the secret Dulce Base. Be mindful of detonators, electricity, and misprogrammed robots. If failed halfway through your unknown mission, try more times equipping different advanced weapons and a variety of skill upgrades. Every trip should bring new random discoveries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/fdfd00ded82d8e37108924d8d9c31f231c07810f.png[/img]

[h2]LIVESTREAM #2[/h2]
Besides the new demo, another Next Fest stream is confirmed to be held at[b] 6pm, Feb. 8th, Pacific Time [/b]on our Steam store page. In this broadcast, we also invite [url=https://twitter.com/IGCollective]Indie Game Collective[/url]'s content creator to try out the game and slash the way through the Dulce Base. Don’t forget to add this event to your calendar and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952370]wishlist [/url][i]Oblivion Override[/i] for more future updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952370

[h2]Q&A - What's in the Demo?[/h2]
To help you know more about the demo details before you embark on the adventure, we prepared a FAQ about the demo content, gameplay systems, and other info:

[h3]Q: How much content is included in the demo?[/h3]
A: The demo version contains [b]the first two maps[/b] of the game - the abandoned factory and the alienated bio-greenhouse, and two deadly boss fights with[b] “Electric Erich” and “Ripper Wright”[/b] awaiting your visit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/46c436875db80143c6388cdf50a0af0608e65939.jpg[/img]

Also, regular enemies will spawn in the two levels as the “first playthrough” difficulty. Don't forget to adjust your weapons and build in the face of different enemies and random combat rooms.

[h3]Q: How many weapons are available in the demo?[/h3]
A: [b]15 weapons are available[/b] in the demo: 4 are initial weapons, 6 are unlockable weapons, and the remaining 5 rare weapons require blueprints and resources to craft - which also have more powerful passive abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/b00207ce1a6bba5bd31b5b28969538516ed2c4f7.png[/img]

There are 10 extra weapons that can't be unlocked, for they may affect the difficulty of early exploration, but you can still see them in the demo.

[h3]Q: What does the Evolution system look like in this demo?[/h3]
A: In this demo, we increased the spawn of “Nanite” as well as the chance of exclusive and fusion abilities to help you upgrade in the first two maps. Also, all core items are available to allow you to grow faster and enjoy the deeper gameplay of [i]Oblivion Override[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/21ed499fee28be4f97adf78539d5ace90970d012.png[/img]

In terms of Evolution paths, we selected [b]8 main features[/b] including "Belligerence", "Rage", "Killing Skill", "Hologram", "SMD-115", "Pulse Mastery", "Spike Core", and "Advanced Tech". These features cover different dimensions from combat to movement, catering to your needs for trying all kinds of builds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/4b1a59d232edd88e18894bf5592bddbde9f302f4.png[/img]

In addition, shops, chest rooms, core rooms, and Nanite rooms will also be accessible in the demo, allowing you to get stronger in various ways to beat levels.

[h3]Q: Does any other major character show in the demo?[/h3]
A: Yes! There are[b] 8 NPCs [/b]and you can bring Mr.Xie, the merchant NPC to your base at the early stage. The NPCs shown in the demo all have their own stories, but some of them can’t be brought to the base in this demo. You can also enter Mecha room in the base and Lee’s room in the greenhouse, but the relevant functions are not available at this moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/425f8fa0bd7a7e6ac10203ef035d718175e2366e.png[/img]

[h3]Q: What languages are supported in the demo?[/h3]
A: We've just updated the initial Japanese translations into the demo. So the current version supports[b] English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese[/b]!

[h3]Q: Can I share content from the demo on any social platforms?[/h3]
A: Yes, of course! No matter if you are a YouTube content creator, or a streamer or not, please feel free to do that! For members of the press, you can contact us via email: indie@xd.com. 

[h3]Q: If I encounter any bugs playing the demo, how can I report the issues?[/h3]
A: You can submit a ticket via [b]the in-game Bug Feedback section[/b] under the Pause menu or join our [url=https://discord.gg/TDHs4MPRXu]official Discord server[/url] and post in the #demo-bug-report channel. Your feedback and suggestions are really important for us to further optimize the gameplay experience!

notes.title: First Gameplay Reveal | Our Team and Initial Design Concepts
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are Humble Mill, the development team of [i]Oblivion Override[/i].

We are incredibly grateful for your interest in our game - the support we’ve gotten since the announcement of [i]Oblivion Override[/i] has just been overwhelming! We are currently working on the [b]English closed beta test[/b] which will also be launching today. 

To get you a better insight into this roguelike hack-n-slasher, please check out our [b]first official gameplay video[/b] here:

[previewyoutube=BPljt1OF6KY;full][previewyoutube=BPljt1OF6KY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

In this dev blog, we will be sharing some of our thoughts and inspirations behind [i]Oblivion Override[/i]. If you have any questions or comments regarding the story and gameplay, please don't hesitate to leave them below. 

[h3]Who are we?[/h3]
We are Humble Mill, an indie game studio of 10, and we’re passionate about playing and creating games! Side-scrollers like the [i]Castlevania[/i] series, [i]Hollow Knight[/i], and [i]Dead Cells[/i] are some of our favorites, and we’ve always dreamed of making our own game in this space. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/74f249f244eba50030e0f31d850dcf135c9bb053.png[/img]
 
Since founding in 2016, we’ve been all about creating action game experiences and launched our first project, [i]Jiu Li[/i], in 2017 for mobile. After that we did some more exploring and prototyping, which led us to [i]Oblivion Override[/i] - our second project, and first attempt on PC.

[h3]What was the inspiration for Oblivion Override?[/h3]
We are all big fans of side-scrolling action games, so wanting to create something in this genre has always been a part of us. Also, we had already accumulated some experience in the development of side-scrollers. While the core gameplay of these games is pretty established, we’re still hoping to find something new and exciting about them.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/0b9e8ba5728a9abf0762239efd7b7efab944c4a7.png[/img]

[h3]How about the art style of the game?[/h3]
It’s tough to put into words what the exact style of the game is. We went with a more dieselpunk design direction for the characters, and introduced quite a bit of post-apocalyptic elements in the game world.
 
After a lot of trial, we were able to land on a visual presentation that we’re happy with, and we hope you’ll like it too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/e4624f53ba24194029e0b286d204da73b8b3ead5.png[/img]

[h3]What are the narrative and gameplay like in Oblivion Override?[/h3]
We wanted to create a world that’s familiar but still feels fresh, with awesome characters and a killer story threading everything together. So we figured that a fragmented narrative felt most proper.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/309a7caf15e72f07f8d32d63027d4273003cc055.png[/img]

We also wanted the player-controlled protagonist to feel super responsive and have lots of room to grow, and that’s how we decided on adopting Roguelike mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/2213c7d8a82ff6dcb5eb307c2e51f4a6ae66d757.png[/img]
 
Some players may be curious about why we chose the words [i]Oblivion[/i] and [i]Override[/i]. For one thing, [i]Oblivion[/i] tries to convey the concept of “annihilation” - the process of turning matter and antimatter into energy when they meet, while [i]Override[/i] is relevant to certain devices to suspend automatic functions on machines. Want to take a wild guess why we named the game with these meanings?

[h2]About Beta Testing[/h2]
Our first round of [b]English closed beta test will be open today[/b] (i.e. Friday at CST time)! 

We will continue accepting [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/u/0/d/e/1FAIpQLSeWgQkQ1lLzddYBcBMMeVRx8VIkuCugNWDuD2_oiJgD4Q47Fw/alreadyresponded?usp=pp_url]application forms[/url] so please don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/TDHs4MPRXu]Official discord[/url] and apply for the playtest there!

[url=https://discord.gg/TDHs4MPRXu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014373/6a47311c505b5598aee2a9f5b3bd84937d6a83ee.jpg[/img][/url]

In future updates, we’ll be showing off some character designs, gameplay mechanics, and sharing some of our plans and ideas. Don’t miss out on all the fun and also make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/oblivion_code]Twitter[/url] to stay up-to-date on our lastest news, exiciting content, and giveaway events.

We'll catch up with you in the next dev blog. Stay tuned and let us know your questions or suggestions in the comments below!
